title: Please criticize my animation and what to do to improve.
author: Useful_Use_6170
selftext:
So I wanted to bring an idea to life, I think I have the foundations already set of course I’m open to ideas if something feels off.

https://undying-ascent-copy-e2fe64b8.base44.app/

Most importantly is the fighting animation I don’t like it it’s off.

I’m not a coder been using sprite sheets and just learned how to add them lol 🤣

comments.author: MightyBig-Dev
comments.body: Consider letting people of start playing without logging in. Then after a little bit, login and capture their account state. Most people aren't willing to login without playing first. Me included. Best of luck.

replies.author: Useful_Use_6170
replies.body: Omg thank you! 😊 so either add it to a tutorial, or in settings thank you for ur input!!

replies.author: MightyBig-Dev
replies.body: Didn't get to play because I don't sign up for anything I don't want or like. Maybe id love your game but I'll never know without a low friction way to play. I made [Nelly Jellies ](http://nellyjellies.com) for free with no accout and I get hundreds of players each day. All the best 👍

comments.author: Ok-Skin-3699
comments.body:
Ok, login stuff aside since you removed it, I think the issue isnt your combat anims, but more that this is a style of game that is fun to mess around in but doesn't really encourage or enable long term persistant players. 


I personally interact with games for story, but a chunky mechanical game feels awesome.


Id honestly recommended redoing the intro, and working the UI to slowly reveal itself as you unlock stuff, as oppsed to showing me 20 tabs that i can't use yet.

replies.author: Useful_Use_6170
replies.body: Yeah I 100% agree I do notice that new players are like what are all these tabs and what do they do or mean. Been trying to figure out how to add maybe like a storyline where as you progress random Npcs will show you what each tab does.
